cronjobs
========

.. tip:: Ingestion into Splunk.

   **``linux:cronjobs``**

   * name_rex: ``\.jsonl$``
   * path_suffix: ``cronjobs``
   * sourcetype: ``linux:cronjobs``
   * host_rex: ``([\w\.-]+?)--``
   * artifact: ``cronjobs``

-----------

Parse cronjobs using dissect plugin
